description: Client-facing notification and confirmation record for every money movement (wallet top-up, loan disbursement, repayment, withdrawal to bank). Each movement generates one row per channel (email, push, in-app) with the Stripe reference, destination bank snapshot, and a status that advances from pending to sent to confirmed once Stripe's webhook (payment_intent.succeeded / payout.paid) proves the money actually moved. Feeds the dashboard movement feed and the 'money available' tile.

fields.name: clientId
fields.description: The client being notified about the movement (lender or borrower).

fields.name: transactionId
fields.description: The money movement this notification describes. Links to stripeTransactions for amount/type/status ground truth.

fields.name: movementType
fields.description: Kind of movement. Allowed values: wallet_top_up, disbursement, loan_repayment, withdrawal. Mirrors stripeTransactions.paymentType at time of creation.

fields.name: channel
fields.description: Delivery channel. Allowed values: email, push, inapp. One row per channel per movement.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Notification/movement state. Allowed values: pending, sent, confirmed, failed. Defaults to pending on create; sent when the email/push is dispatched; confirmed when the Stripe webhook proves the movement completed (payment_intent.succeeded for charges, payout.paid for withdrawals); failed on dispatch error or payout.failed. FK to transactionNotifications_status.statusCode.

fields.name: recipientEmail
fields.description: Email address the notification was sent to (snapshot; channel=email only).

fields.name: subject
fields.description: Email/push title, e.g. 'Retiro de $500.00 MXN en camino a tu cuenta Santander ****9965'.

fields.name: messageBody
fields.description: Full rendered message body sent to the client.

fields.name: amount
fields.description: Movement amount snapshot in company currency, decimal(18,2).

fields.name: stripeReference
fields.description: Stripe object backing the movement: pi_* (charge), po_* (payout), or tr_* (transfer). This is what support quotes to confirm money movement.

fields.name: bankName
fields.description: Destination bank snapshot for withdrawals/disbursements, from stripeConnectedAccounts.externalAccountBankName.

fields.name: confirmedAt
fields.description: When the Stripe webhook confirmed the underlying movement (money verifiably moved).

fields.name: failureReason
fields.description: Dispatch error or Stripe failure detail (e.g. payout.failed reason).

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
clientId references clients; a client accumulates many movement notifications.
Each stripeTransactions row can raise one notification per channel (email/push/inapp).

components.name: MovementFeedStep
components.description: IonList feed of the client's movements (inapp rows), newest first: icon per movementType, amount, status badge (pending=gray, sent=blue, confirmed=green, failed=red), relative date. IonSelect filter by movementType/status. Reused inside the lender and borrower dashboards' Actividad section.

components.name: MovementDetailModal
components.description: IonModal opened from a feed row: full audit trail — amount, currency, movementType, stripeReference (pi_/po_/tr_), destination bankName + bankLast4, transactionId, sentAt, confirmedAt, failureReason. This answers 'which account, which bank, which transaction, did the money really leave'.

components.name: WalletAvailableCard
components.description: Compact card for the dashboards showing money available now: wallet availableBalance (from /wallet) plus the last confirmed movement line. Replaces the static $0 'Capital total' impression when funds exist.

endpoints.description: Create + send the notifications for one transaction: inserts one row per channel (email via contact_email Gmail sender, push via sp_pushNotifications/Azure NH, inapp row only), then updates each row to sent/failed with sentAt or failureReason. Body: { companyId, transactionId }. Idempotent per (transactionId, channel).

Called from the Stripe webhook glue on payment_intent.succeeded, payout.paid and payout.failed: marks the movement's rows confirmed (or failed with the Stripe failure reason), stamps confirmedAt, and dispatches the confirmation email ('tu retiro llegó a tu cuenta Santander ****9965'). Requires the Stripe webhook endpoint to subscribe to payout.paid and payout.failed in addition to the current events.
